credits.title: Nine
credits.overview: They thought they were coming back to a house. Instead, they lose themselves inside a mind. And some won't make it out. Nine is a psychological thriller that dives deep into a mind at war - an intimate yet universal experience about the courage it takes to fully exist.

credits.title: Thicker Than Water, Thinner Than Blood
credits.overview: A devout Christian mother's carefully ordered life is disrupted, forcing her to confront the limits of her faith, the weight of guilt, and the expectations placed on her as a woman. As her beliefs and long-held convictions are tested, she must navigate the tension between personal truth and societal pressures.

credits.title: 37 : The Shadow and the Prey
credits.overview: Vincent, a truck driver, picks up a young pregnant woman. She turns out to have an unstable temper… and an automatic pistol. She orders Vincent to continue driving, without stopping. When he's out of gas, she'll kill him.

credits.title: Just for Laughs
credits.overview: Michel and Juliette have just broken up over Michel's affair with the much younger Romance. Alice and Nicolas are still together, but maybe this is because Nicolas does not know of Alice's affair with handsome sports photographer Gaspard.
